title: T0 PDF crate verification spike — round 1 (scratch crate, empirical probes)
detail: Throwaway scratch crate at target/tmp/pdf-spike/ (untracked, not added to workspace) exercising lopdf 0.44.0 page ops, get_page_images, krilla 0.8.2 Font requirement, and pdf-extract 0.12.0 MediaBox-panic containment. Round 1 covered only the MediaBox panic case for pdf-extract failure modes; missing-ToUnicode, Type0/CID, scanned/no-text-layer, and malformed-xref remain unverified pending round 2.
